title: IPPL — A Performance-Portable, Massively Parallel Distributed Nonuniform FFT (PASC '26 reproducibility artifact)
description:
Reproducibility artifact accompanying the PASC '26 paper A Performance-Portable, Massively Parallel Distributed Nonuniform FFT by Fischill, Adelmann, and Muralikrishnan. This snapshot of the IPPL framework contains the distributed NUFFT and Particle-in-Fourier solver, together with the raw benchmark data and a single self-contained plotting script (results/revised/plot_paper.py) that regenerates the twelve figures used in the manuscript.

Tested on Alps (CSCS, NVIDIA GH200), JUWELS Booster (JSC, NVIDIA A100), and LUMI (CSC, AMD MI250X).
